title: Name actions with verbs
summary: Function names should explain what the action does. A reader should not need to inspect every line to understand a call.
introduction: Function names should explain what the action does. A reader should not need to inspect every line to understand a call. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Function names should explain what the action does. A reader should not need to inspect every line to understand a call.

blocks.code:
function addPrices(first, second) { return first + second; }
console.log(addPrices(3, 4));
blocks.title: Name actions with verbs

blocks.text: The result is 7. The function name says it adds prices.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Name a function that removes a saved book.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Avoid names such as doStuff that hide the purpose.
For more detail later, use this [Clean Code further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/MDN/Writing_guidelines/Code_style_guide/JavaScript).
